title: Start a fresh guest run
description: Login, personality questions, partner selection and the opening of a normal run.

captions.text: Choose Play as guest for a fresh local trial.
Answer the eight personality questions. The result is a recommendation.
Accept the suggested partner or choose another.
Read the starting move, then confirm a partner.
Choose Play to enter the dungeon.
Move with WASD. The active attack fires automatically.

title: Golden evolution card: controlled demonstration
description: Prerequisites are preconfigured in a disposable local session: Ember level five and Power, followed by the developer level-up trigger. The game then offers Fire Blast and evolves the move when selected. This is not an unassisted run.

captions.text: Controlled demo: prerequisites will be preconfigured. This is not an unassisted run.
Ember level five + Power in this run. The developer level-up trigger opens the genuine golden Fire Blast offer.
Select the golden card to evolve the move. This demonstrates the engine response, not earning the prerequisites.

source: Local unbundled dev.html engine, source snapshot b297089
scope: Controlled test fixture. G.Moves.levelUp applied until Ember level 5; Power applied via the real stat method; statsTaken.atk set to 1; G.Game.debugLevelUp triggers the offer. Golden card selected through the real UI. Visible editorial label is present throughout.
